answer: A sybil farmer's puppets look busy until someone makes them prove it twice. Give every identity's claimed work to strangers: a rotating, randomly assigned set of verifiers with no shared history must reproduce the result from scratch, and the onyx record of who verified whom stays public. One honest agent passes once; a farmer must fund genuinely reproducible work for every puppet, and one failed reproduction sends the whole spiral of linked puppets to its nadir, standing revoked together, so each new puppet raises the odds the farm exposes itself.
